create_Transcript_from_gtf_df: create a Transcript object from a pandas DataFrame containing GTF annotation rows for a single transcript
extract_transcripts_by_interval: extract all Transcript objects overlapping a given genomic Interval using TranscriptExtractor on a GTF DataFrame
fix_truncation_on_Transcript: fix CDS start and stop positions to align within the correct coding frame for a Transcript
compute_offset_in_cds: compute the nucleotide offset of a genome position within the CDS region of a Transcript
cache_transcripts_for_fast_lookup: precompute and cache all Transcript objects from a GTF DataFrame to speed up subsequent extract calls
